{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Sleeveless A-line gown with a softly fitted bodice, a defined waist and a full skirt, floor-length, deep sage green #4F7A6B, matte silk crepe

Block-heel sandals with a thin ankle strap, heel to the mid-height range, champagne gold #C9A66B, satin

Small structured clutch, slim rectangle with a clasp, antique gold #B89B5E, metallic crepe

Drop earrings, slim teardrop with a freshwater pearl, pale gold #D8BE82 and pearl #F1E9DA, gold-plated metal

Thin bracelet, delicate open cuff, soft gold #D8BE82, polished metal

This deep sage green echoes the grey-green of your eyes and sets off your golden hair and warm skin without competing with the bride. The silk crepe is a noble fabric that suits a formal wedding and your role as the bride's sister, while the long, flowing skirt stays comfortable in August warmth and photographs well outdoors. Bare arms are the only open area, which keeps the look elegant and balanced. Block heels hold steady on grass at the ceremony and stay comfortable through dinner at the restaurant, and the soft gold accessories tie everything together without heaviness."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2580,"output_tokens":908},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
